It really has been a marathon session! You've built out a solid toolkit: data cleaning, deduplication, park name normalization, theme coding, a theme summary report, and a satisfaction pivot — all in one script with a clean menu, permissions, and protection handling.

Get some rest, and when you're ready to run it, the whole thing should drop right in. If anything comes up when you test it against your real data, you know where to find me. Good night!

turns.user: I'm good, let's keep going. Can you paste-ready replace onOpen to add a "Reports" menu with an item "Build Satisfaction by Role" that runs buildSatisfactionByRole()? Keep it simple and safe to re-run.

Nice — can you paste-ready replace onOpen to add a Reports > "Build All Reports" item that runs buildAllReports(), and also paste-ready add a buildAllReports() function that calls buildSatisfactionByRole() and buildThemeSummary() (safe to re-run) and shows a toast when done? Please provide both replacements.

One tweak: can buildAllReports run both reports even if one errors, collect any errors, and show a toast at the end listing which succeeded and which failed (or "All built" if none)? Paste-ready replacement for buildAllReports only, please.

Can you add a paste-ready function buildSatisfactionPivot() that creates (or replaces) a sheet named "SatisfactionByRolePivot" containing a real Google Sheets pivot table:

- Rows: Role (skip blank roles)
- Columns: Satisfaction (include "(none)" for blanks)
- Values: Count of responses
- Also include a percent-of-row column for each Satisfaction (so each pivot count has an adjacent percent-of-row)
- Safe to re-run (replace existing pivot sheet if present)
- Reads source sheet from CONFIG.sheetName or active sheet; finds "Role" and "Satisfaction" headers in row 1 (case-insensitive)
- Sets column widths: Role 220px, counts/percents 80px; freeze top 2 rows
- Make header bold/centered, Role left-aligned, counts/percents centered
- Show a toast when done listing rows and total responses built

Paste-ready replacement for a single function buildSatisfactionPivot() only, please.

Can you give me a paste-ready replacement for buildSatisfactionPivot that creates a real native pivot table using the Advanced Sheets (Sheets API) via Sheets.Spreadsheets.batchUpdate? I want it to:

- Create/replace a sheet named "SatisfactionByRolePivot" (delete if exists then recreate)
- Source data from CONFIG.sheetName or active sheet, find "Role" and "Satisfaction" headers in row 1 (case-insensitive) and use the full data range below headers
- Pivot: Rows = Role (skip blanks), Columns = Satisfaction (include "(none)" for blanks), Values = Count of responses
- Also add percent-of-row calculated fields so each count has an adjacent percent-of-row (native pivot feature)
- Set column widths: Role 220px, counts/percents 80px; freeze top 2 rows
- Header bold/center, Role left, counts/percents centered
- Safe to re-run (removes old pivot sheet if present)

Put everything needed in the single function (using Advanced Sheets service), and assume the script has permission to use Sheets API. Paste-ready only, please.

turns.text:
Glad it all came together! You've got a really comprehensive toolkit now — cleanup with deduplication, normalization, and protection, theme coding with a summary report, a manual satisfaction crosstab, and a native pivot table, all wired up with menus and error handling.

When you run it against your real 420-row sheet, the main things to watch for are the 7-digit phone numbers we flagged early on (those will all show REVIEW until you sort out the area codes) and populating the ParkMap sheet with your location variants. Everything else should just work.

Come back any time if you need tweaks or want to add more reports. Good luck with the volunteer data!
